title: Flamboyant: Repalletized
description: Adds 20 brand new dyes for decoration!
body:
Flamboyant: Repalletized is a port of the Flamboyant Recrafted mod., which is a port of the Flamboyant mod. The series just continues, huh....
 
This mod adds 20 brand new dyes, all craftable using existing vanilla dyes! They can be used to make decorative wool, carpets, concrete, terracotta, and glass!
 

 

 

 

Credits:
